title: Build recordings browser and recording details
description:
Create a recordings browser page and view model that exposes the RecordingIndex to QML, allowing users to browse past captures, view recording details, and perform actions (reveal in file manager, delete from index).

Before editing, inspect:
- src/history/RecordingIndex.hpp for the RecordingEntry struct and RecordingIndex API
- src/ui/ for existing ViewModel patterns and Q_PROPERTY conventions
- qml/pages/ for existing page structure and import conventions
- qml/Main.qml for navigation pattern (do NOT modify Main.qml in this task)

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
1. Create src/ui/RecordingsViewModel.hpp declaring a RecordingsViewModel that wraps RecordingIndex as a QAbstractListModel. Expose roles for all RecordingEntry fields. Add Q_INVOKABLE methods: revealInFileManager(int index), removeEntry(int index), refreshEntries().
2. Create src/ui/RecordingsViewModel.cpp implementing the list model with proper beginResetModel/endResetModel calls on data changes. revealInFileManager() uses QDesktopServices::openUrl on the parent directory. removeEntry() calls RecordingIndex::remove() and refreshes.
3. Create qml/pages/RecordingsPage.qml with a ListView bound to RecordingsViewModel, showing file name, format, duration, sample rate, bit depth, and timestamp for each entry. Include a details panel or delegate expansion showing full recording metadata and the native-vs-converted indicator. Add context menu or buttons for reveal and delete actions. Show an empty-state message when no recordings exist.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/ui/RecordingsViewModel.hpp exists and declares RecordingsViewModel as QAbstractListModel subclass
src/ui/RecordingsViewModel.cpp exists and implements roleNames(), rowCount(), data() for all RecordingEntry fields
Q_INVOKABLE revealInFileManager() and removeEntry() methods are declared and implemented
qml/pages/RecordingsPage.qml exists with a ListView bound to the view model
RecordingsPage.qml displays file name, format, duration, sample rate, bit depth, timestamp, and native-vs-converted flag
RecordingsPage.qml shows an empty-state message when no recordings exist
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add media playback or audio preview functionality

allowed: choose details panel layout vs delegate expansion
choose context menu vs inline action buttons
forbidden: add audio playback or waveform preview in the browser
